seo.title: Curve Slide
seo.description: The 5-Foot Curve Slide by Fun Play Systems offers a thrilling and safe sliding experience with a smooth curve, perfect for kids to enjoy exciting playtime.

data.description: At 5 ft high, this Curve Slide gives children a longer, faster ride than our 3 ft version while staying manageable for a primary school or society garden. The red and yellow slide bends to one side on the way down, and children climb up by a steel ladder. The curve means the exit points away from the ladder, which helps you plan the slide into a corner of the play area. A 5 ft slide sits in the middle of our height range, so it suits mixed groups of younger and older children. We warranty its galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts for 3 years when installed and maintained as we advise. Ask us whether a taller slide would suit your children better.

items.pText: At 5 ft high, this Curve Slide gives children a longer, faster ride than our 3 ft version while staying manageable for a primary school or society garden. The red and yellow slide bends to one side on the way down, and children climb up by a steel ladder. The curve means the exit points away from the ladder, which helps you plan the slide into a corner of the play area. A 5 ft slide sits in the middle of our height range, so it suits mixed groups of younger and older children. We warranty its galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts for 3 years when installed and maintained as we advise. Ask us whether a taller slide would suit your children better.

The ladder and supports are galvanised steel and the curved bed is a weather-proof moulding. We grout it into the ground or set it on a self-standing base. Keep an impact-absorbing surface at the foot and beside the ladder, and inspect the joints and steps during maintenance.
